questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.topic: Gibbs Free Energy & Equilibrium Quotient
questions.question: For a reversible phase transition $\text{H}_2\text{O}(l) \rightleftharpoons \text{H}_2\text{O}(g)$ at $100^\circ\text{C}$ and $1\text{ atm}$ in [Chemical Thermodynamics], which of the following thermodynamic statements is strictly true?
questions.solution: At normal boiling point, liquid and vapor are in dynamic thermodynamic equilibrium at constant $T$ and $P$, so $\Delta G = 0$. For a reversible process, $\Delta S_{sys} = \frac{\Delta H_{rev}}{T} = \frac{\Delta H_{vap}}{373.15\text{ K}}$.
questions.explanation: Analyze using fundamental chemical principles in Chemical Thermodynamics.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.topic: Gibbs Free Energy & Equilibrium Quotient
questions.question: What is the basicity (number of ionizable hydrogen atoms per molecule) of pyrophosphoric acid $(\text{H}_4\text{P}_2\text{O}_7)$ in [Chemical Thermodynamics]?
questions.solution: Pyrophosphoric acid contains two tetrahedral phosphorus atoms connected by a $\text{P-O-P}$ bridge, with four $-\text{OH}$ groups attached directly to phosphorus. All four hydrogens are acidic, so its basicity is $4$.
questions.explanation: Calculate using quantitative laws in Chemical Thermodynamics.
